description:
Replays a yearly withdrawal, raised with real inflation, from every start month the
        portfolio's history allows: how many starts lasted the full span, how many ran
        out and when, the lowest point from the worst start, and the highest yearly
        rate that ran out from no start. Use it for 'can I live off this?'; for money
        put in every month instead, monthly_plan. amount is the portfolio's value
        (defaults to the sum of the holdings), withdrawal the yearly amount in today's
        money, years the span (5 to 50, default 30). A count of starts, never a
        probability; a span the record is too short for is said, not invented.

amount.description: How much is in the portfolio, when `holdings` are weights rather than money.
amount.title: Amount

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

withdrawal.description: Taken each year, in today's money; raised with the real price index of the base currency.
withdrawal.title: Withdrawal

name: living_off_it

outputSchema.description: Withdrawals replayed on the portfolio's own monthly history (replayed).

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

amount.description: Money in the portfolio at each start.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

inflation.description: Price index used: source, last_published, assumed.

n_complete.description: Starts old enough for the full span.

n_going.description: Recent starts not run out so far, span not over.

n_ran_out.description: Starts, complete or not, where the money ran out.

record.description: start, end and years of the shared monthly record.

safe_rate.description: Highest yearly rate that ran out from no start; null if no start is complete.

starts.description: A sample of starts (every sixth): start, complete, months, ran_out, low_real, end_real.

testable_years.description: The longest span the record can test in full.

withdrawal.description: Taken each year, in start-month money, raised with prices.

worst.description: The worst start: start, ran_out, months, low_real, low_at, end_real.

title: Living off it: withdrawals replayed
